settings.remerge: Re-merge items that should be one card
settings.remergeFieldHint: Some older entries were filed before the grouping rules changed. This re-applies today's rules to what's already in the library — it only updates grouping, and never moves a file.
settings.remergeHint: Press Check first and see exactly what would merge. Ctrl+Z undoes the whole batch afterwards.

settings.remergeAmbiguous: {{count}} more look too similar to merge automatically — left for you to decide
settings.remergeDone: Merged: {{clusters}} groups / {{moved}} cards moved / {{groups}} empty groups removed
